description: Read-only corridor evidence: public published rates, public posts, on-chain pool prints and user receipts, summarised by corridor and provider type (bank, fintech, card, stablecoin). The free answer is the summary: how many rows, the median markup percent, the date range and the evidence label (published, user receipt, public post, on-chain, user-submitted). Row-level sources are not in the free answer. They are at GET https://swapeazi.io/api/v1/corridor-evidence/rows with a paid key or x402. Does not hold or move money. A record, not a ranking.

corridor.description: Currency pair as published, for example 'EUR/ZAR' or 'EUR-ZAR'.

detail.description: summary (the default) or full. Full rows need a paid key.

provider_type.description: bank, fintech, card or stablecoin. Omit for every type.
